summary: Superseded by v2.4.3 . Google Play did not accept this build (version code 35) for review: it required the android.hardware.wifi hardware feature, which hid the app from devices without Wi-Fi. 2.4.3 makes Wi-Fi optional and contains the same fixes. The 2.4.2 APKs still install by sideloading. CyanBridge 2.4.2 is a fix release for 2.4.1. It fixes HeyCyan live preview sometimes failing to start. Recommended installation: Google Play For most users, the recommended way to install and update CyanBridge is through Google Play: Download CyanBridge from Google Play Google Play provides the simplest update path, automatic updates, and Play Protect checks. Availability of version 2.4.2 may follow the configured Play rollout. The APKs attached below are for users who specifically need direct sideloading. The AAB is for Play Console and testing tracks and cannot be installed directly. Fixes HeyCyan live preview no longer fails with "No RTSP found" when it is started again. What happened: the app
